title: BuildCreativeError
description: Body of a failed build_creative response: operation-level errors, and none of the success fields. The completed body also admits this body.

errors.description: Array of errors explaining why creative generation failed. For a canonical multi-output request, an output-scoped failure MUST set `error.field` to `target_capability_ids[N]` and SHOULD include the rejected value in `error.details.capability_id`. Whole-batch failures may omit output attribution. Deprecated target_format_ids requests retain legacy attribution during the 3.x compatibility window.
